sloka: रक्षणीया विशेषेण राज दारा महाबलः ।निवर्तय गतिम् नीचाम् पर दार अभिमर्शनात् ॥३-५०-७॥
transliteration: rakṣaṇīyā viśeṣeṇa rāja dārā mahābalaḥ ।nivartaya gatim nīcām para dāra abhimarśanāt ॥3-50-7॥

translations.english: Refrain yourself from the vile thought of violating other's wives. Wise men do not adopt what is censured by others. Just like one's own, the wise should protect other's wives.
